convention: start = first day children do not attend (day after last term day, usually Saturday); end = last holiday day (day before school resumes). A null end means next-year term dates are not yet published by the official body. Only breaks overlapping 2026-11-01..2028-12-31 are included.

regions.name: New South Wales
regions.notes: Public-school EASTERN division. Also opened https://education.nsw.gov.au/schooling/calendars/2026.html (2026 dates). Western division differs only in Term 1 start and therefore the end of summer: summer 2026-27 ends 2027-02-03 (T1 starts 2027-02-04), summer 2027-28 ends 2028-02-06 (T1 starts 2028-02-07), summer 2028-29 ends 2029-02-02 per NSW page. Convention: start = day after last term day; end = day before next term first day (NSW term dates include staff development days; NSW lists holidays Mon-Fri only so these ranges also include the weekends). Summer 2027-28: NSW page lists T4 ending Fri 17 Dec 2027 but summer holidays starting Tue 21 Dec with Mon 20 Dec a staff development day; I used start 2027-12-18 (day after listed term end). Summer 2028-29 end 2029-01-25 is NSW-listed (Thu), not derived. A separate page https://education.nsw.gov.au/schooling/calendars/2027.html returned different 2027 dates (T1 3 Feb, T3 Tue 20 Jul) that conflict with the main future-dates page and fail weekday sanity; the future-dates page was used. A few schools near VIC/QLD borders use different dates. Catholic and independent schools may differ.

regions.name: Victoria
regions.notes: Government schools. Convention: start = day after last term day (Fri); end = day before next term first student day. Term 1 students start the day after teachers (2027-01-28, 2028-01-28). Summer 2028-29 end not published on the page (2029 not listed) so end is null. Catholic/independent schools generally follow the same dates but can vary.

regions.name: Queensland
regions.notes: State schools. Also opened https://education.qld.gov.au/about-us/calendar/term-dates (2026 term dates). 2027 and 2028 breaks are the official Holidays rows from the future-dates page. Summer 2026-27 derived from 2026 T4 end (Fri 2026-12-11) and 2027 T1 start (Wed 2027-01-27); staff PD days (2027-01-21 to 01-25) fall inside it. Non-state schools may differ.

regions.name: South Australia
regions.notes: Public schools; term dates are inclusive. Convention: start = day after last term day; end = day before next term first day. Summer 2028-29 end null (2029 not on page). Catholic/independent may differ.

regions.name: Western Australia
regions.notes: Public schools; term dates are inclusive; schools have planned development days. Convention: start = day after last term day; end = day before next term first day. Summer 2028-29 end null (2029 not on page). Independent/Catholic may differ.

regions.name: Tasmania
regions.notes: Government schools (page redirected from education.tas.gov.au). Only 2026 and 2027 are published; 2028 NOT published, so 2028 breaks are omitted and the 2027-28 summer end is null. Colleges (Yrs 11-12) set own finish dates. Convention: start = day after last term day; end = day before next term first day.

regions.name: Australian Capital Territory
regions.notes: Public schools; ACT Government 2026-30 term dates PDF (opened and text-extracted); 2026-27 cross-checked on https://www.act.gov.au/living-in-the-act/public-holidays-school-terms-and-daylight-savings. Convention: start = day after last term day; end = day before first STUDENT day (teacher student-free days fall inside the break; for Term 1 the new-student start date is used, continuing students return a day later). Catholic/independent may differ.

regions.name: Northern Territory
regions.notes: NOT DIRECTLY OPENED: nt.gov.au and its calendar PDFs returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. Dates come from search-engine excerpts of the official nt.gov.au page/PDFs (2026 T4 student finish Thu 2026-12-10; 2027 students: T1 Wed 27 Jan-Fri 2 Apr, T2 Tue 13 Apr-Fri 18 Jun, T3 Tue 13 Jul-Fri 17 Sep, T4 Tue 5 Oct-Thu 9 Dec) and are consistent with the NT 1/3/2/6-week holiday structure, but should be re-verified. 2028 NOT published (2028-2032 consultation was open); summer 2027-28 end is null. Convention: start = day after last student day; end = day before next student day. Gunbalanya runs a flexible calendar; non-government schools check direct.

regions.name: New Zealand
regions.notes: Ministry of Education page, cross-checked with NZ Gazette notice https://gazette.govt.nz/notice/id/2025-sl5849 (2027-2028). Terms 2 and 3 are fixed nationally; schools choose Term 1 start and Term 4 end within a window, so the Summer rows are the GUARANTEED window: start = day after the latest allowed Term 4 end; end = day before the EARLIEST allowed Term 1 start (individual schools may break up earlier / return later). Summer 2028-29 end null (2029 not published). Term 1 break 2028 is Fri 14 Apr-Sun 30 Apr as published. State and most integrated schools follow these; check the school.
